title: Describe and guess, for two children (FR-24)

rounds.description: Rounds in a game. The children take turns giving the clues.

lines.description: Gui's lines. {describer}, {guesser}, {option} and {n} are filled in.

unit.description: Used once both children have reached this unit.

emoji.description: Stand-in picture until there's an illustration.

name.description: With its article, pt-PT, e.g. "o gelado".

say.description: The guess as the guesser says it, e.g. "É um gelado!".

accept.description: The word itself and its other forms, normalised. "É um…" around it is fine.

clueWords.description: Hearing any of these, normalised, counts as a clue.
